query_analysis.original_query: How do we safely handle and dispose of spent adsorbents from a PSA system used for hydrogen purification?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Develop a comprehensive procedure for the safe handling and environmentally compliant disposal of spent adsorbent materials from a pressure swing adsorption (PSA) system utilized in hydrogen purification processes.

selected_agents.role: Hazard assessment and safety protocol development
Adsorbent characterization and disposal method evaluation

communication_strategy.information_flow: Iterative risk assessment and mitigation planning
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Joint review of adsorbent properties and disposal options

clarification_questions: What specific adsorbent materials are used in the PSA system?
Are there any known hazardous properties associated with the spent adsorbents?
What are the current disposal practices for similar waste streams in the facility?
